blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines—The Toledo-Xignex Trojans continued their impressive campaign in the Professional Chess Association of the Philippines (PCAP) Wesley So Cup, scoring back-to-back victories over the Rizal Batch Towers and Arriba Iriga Oragons. The Trojans first dismantled Rizal, 15-6, behind the solid performance of Grandmaster (GM) Rogelio Barcenilla Jr., who scored twin victories over Marlon Constantino in both the blitz and rapid rounds. Toledo edged Rizal, 4-3, in the blitz round, drawing first blood through Paul Sanchez, who defeated Leo Anthony Rabulan on Board 2, and International Master (IM) Kim Steven Yap, who beat Givy Bartolome on Board 6.
